Every finding was checked against the transcript; take = applied to edited_predicted/timestamps_raw.txt or pieces.json (possibly reworded), partial = applied in part, reject = not applied, with the reason. Raw reports: scratchpad codex_vahagn/review_<section>.md (copied to <output dir>/edited_predicted/review_codex.md).
